rounds.text: Sun Retail Ltd trades at an extraordinary discount, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.27x based on a share price of ₹ 0.29 and a book value of ₹ 1.06 [E1]. This valuation is even more striking when compared to the broader sector benchmark price-to-book ratio of 1.54x, highlighting a massive divergence between the company's asset backing and its market price [E6]. Beneath this depressed valuation, the business demonstrates an ability to expand its top-line across medium-term horizons, achieving a compounded sales growth rate of 29% over 5 years [E14]. Furthermore, the company has proven its capacity to generate bottom-line expansion, delivering a compounded profit growth of 23% over 3 years [E17]. Operational momentum has also shown flashes of resilience, with recent screens highlighting that sales are up quarter-over-quarter [E58]. Conceded: [E3], [E13], [E16], [E18], [E61].
